story.title: The Glass Embassy
story.subtitle: A perfume launch masks an auction for the identity of a vanished double agent.
story.premise: Madame Sabine Vautrin's private unveiling of a Riviera perfume called Ambassade de Verre brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Sabine Vautrin; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.
story.hostRole: Sabine Vautrin, perfumer and intelligence broker; then Game Master

story.solution: Étienne was SABLE. He altered Sabine’s drink during the perfume toast, then encouraged everyone to treat the coded formula as a commercial dispute. Sabine’s separate promises explain every suspect’s secrecy; the overlapping memories prove Étienne alone understood the code before her death.

clues.text: Sabine scheduled a private conversation with each guest under a different commercial pretext.
The initials in the disputed formula spell SABLE when read as intelligence call signs.
Étienne used the word “handler” before anyone publicly said the formula concerned espionage.
A cottage appointment places Étienne close enough to learn Sabine planned to reveal SABLE that night.
The fatal dose acted during the toast, not earlier in the evening.
